baseline_original_timing_reference.interpretation: Saved five-pair, unprofiled timing. cProfile is used only for relative call hot spots.

limitations: Five repeated trials on one machine; OS scheduling and thermal variance remain.
Lower ray counts can miss hazards between angular samples; a single successful episode cannot establish their safety.

method.episode_wall: scene construction plus full episode; excludes payload/artifact I/O
method.evaluation_loop: inside run_episode; includes sensing, safety, collision check, contact and metric accounting
method.ray_count_variants: lower counts preserve 360 degree FOV, 2m range, sample spacing; uniform endpoint-inclusive angular sampling
method.scan_timing: IndependentEmergencySafetySensor.scan; per-scan values pooled across five episodes
